summary: Patria Investments Limited filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, disclosing its second quarter 2026 earnings results via press release and presentation. The filing reports financial metrics including Fee-Related Earnings of $57.1 million, Distributable Earnings of $50.7 million ($0.32 per share), and a quarterly dividend of $0.1625 per share declared. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The registrant is the issuer reporting ordinary operational and financial results, with no extraordinary corporate event or transaction described.
